profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, traded under the ticker CCC, with SEC CIK 0001818201. The website associated with it in the source material is calgoncarbon.com, whose text describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon provider addressing air and water purification challenges. That text does not describe insurance or software operations, so the site content and the company name do not line up.

Per that site, Calgon Carbon's FILTRASORB is a reagglomerated, coal-based activated carbon that the company says has been proven over more than 40 years in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings. The site states FILTRASORB is made in the United States.

The held facts list no products, no MCP servers, and no individual lawsuits for the company. Litigation exposure is recorded against Illinois with a count of 375.
